title: Flutter Mobile App Developer Intern
description:
Job Title: Flutter Mobile App Developer Intern Job Type: Internship Experience: Fresher / Students / Recent Graduates Work Mode: On-site / Remote / Hybrid Duration: 36 Months (Flexible) 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a motivated Flutter Mobile App Developer Intern who is passionate about building high-quality mobile applications. The selected candidate will work with our development team to design, develop, test, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS using Flutter and Dart. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain mobile applications using Flutter and Dart. Build responsive and user-friendly UI screens based on design requirements. Integrate REST APIs and work with JSON data. Implement application features, navigation, and state management. Collaborate with designers, backend developers, and other team members. Debug issues, test application functionality, and improve performance. Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code. Participate in code reviews and team discussions. Learn and apply mobile app development best practices. Required Skills 
 Basic knowledge of Flutter and Dart. Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts. Familiarity with widgets, layouts, navigation, and UI design in Flutter. Basic knowledge of REST APIs and JSON. Familiarity with Git and GitHub. Good problem-solving and communication skills. Willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively. Preferred Qualifications 
 Knowledge of state management tools such as Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc. Familiarity with Firebase, authentication, and cloud databases. Understanding of mobile app testing and debugging. Experience with Android Studio or Visual Studio Code. Personal projects or academic projects built using Flutter. Eligibility 
 Students pursuing or graduates of Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Freshers with a strong interest in mobile application development are encouraged to apply. Candidates with a portfolio or GitHub projects will have an advantage. What You Will Gain 
 Hands-on experience developing real-world mobile applications. Mentorship from experienced developers. Exposure to API integration, debugging, and version control. Opportunities to improve technical and teamwork skills. Internship certificate and potential full-time opportunities based on performance, where applicable.
